title: Deduplicate the CI history secret scan after hosted PLAY-04 re-check run overran its time limit
actor: Claude Code agent (architect/QA reviewer role) on Director request, local WSL session

changes.description: RUN-20261018-003 observes public GitHub metadata for hosted Foundation run 38952419789 on claude/play-04-opening-fix-audit at e2fe87d: failure, 2026-10-16 19:06:24-19:22:25Z. The failed-step output, viewed with gh for diagnosis only (not saved), shows all 14 stages passing (including the repaired supervisor test at 19.9 s, all database/live-match stages, 11 Chromium checks and engine-browser) and then the docker compose run of pnpm ci:verify timing out at 900 s with no further output.

Cause: sourceSecretScan runs before and after the stages; its history pass listed every commit's tree and spawned git cat-file for every blob, rescanning unchanged blobs per commit. First scan 4 min 25 s (19:07:18-19:11:43Z) versus 1 min 52 s on run 38681078184 (2026-10-15); stages 6.8 min; the second scan exceeded the 900 s limit. Locally 44 commits mean 60,974 reads per pass for 3,591 distinct path/version pairs.

scripts/ci/security.mjs: the history pass keeps a set of hash+path keys and reads each distinct path/version once; every entry of every revision is still type-checked (symlink/non-blob refused). scanSecrets, patterns, known values, exceptions, shallow refusal and errors unchanged. tests/ci/gates.test.mjs adds a regression: a credential present only in an older revision, beside a file unchanged across revisions, is still reported for that path without its value.

RUN-20261018-001 test:ci: 14 Node + 10 Python tests pass. RUN002 previous (e2fe87d) versus repaired scan on the full local history: 60,974 vs 3,591 reads; clean scans both pass (179.3 s vs 11.8 s); a known value present only in an older AGENTS.md is rejected by both with the identical finding. Child exit 0; receipt clock_changed.

PLAY-04 validation section; dated notes in docs/runbooks/ci.md, BOOT-03 validation and ADR0005; F-CI description/evidence and FEATURES.md row; re-check lines in AGENTS.md/README.md/docs/README.md; handoff.
